Widen a word over the nouns beside it

Source: R/console_view.R
widen_to_compound.Rd

Internal function for sujimichi_lines(). An analyser splits a compound word it does not know, and the pieces sit next to each other as nouns. The run of nouns around position is put back together, and taken only when it reads in the sentence as it stands; a lemma that differs from what was written would otherwise produce a string that is nowhere in the text.

Usage

widen_to_compound(words, sentence_id, position, word, text)

Arguments

words

A data.frame as returned by content_words().

sentence_id

The sentence the word is in.

position

The place of the word among the morphemes.

word

A string. The shared word itself.

text

A string. The sentence as written.

Value

A string: the compound, or word when there is none.
